displayName: Database getting busy: CPU above 70% for 15 minutes

documentation.content: The database has less than a third of its CPU left, so a busy hour could make the workspace slow. This is the early warning, before the alert at 80%. First step: docs/runbooks/capacity.md, 'What to watch' and 'Scale up, in order of cost'. Open Cloud SQL > alyr-db > Query insights for the slow query.
